targets.strategy: Taiwan secondhand electronics repair, test, part-out and resale
targets.geography: Taiwan, starting with accessible Taoyuan and Taiwan-wide listing channels
targets.capture_method: Acquire underpriced defective devices only after a reproducible test, then repair, part out or resell with recorded after-fee sale receipts
targets.owner_thesis: Hardware Splicer diagnostic/electrical/mechanical layers may help identify repairable failures more cheaply, but actual yield, supply and resale demand are unverified
targets.first_falsification: Collect ten condition-matched buy/sold quotes, actual repair components and shipping fees, test five nonhazardous units and require positive failure-adjusted after-labor spread

targets.strategy: Battery and e-waste process economic modeling and acquisition-price errors
targets.geography: Taiwan-first research relevance, with global academic and repository benchmarks
targets.capture_method: Use original source checks to avoid erroneous gate-fee calculations in sourcing or investment decisions, and validate against operator feedstock transactions
targets.owner_thesis: The reproduced model sign error could cause misvaluation or wrong acquisition bids, but a source defect is not necessarily a tradeable price discrepancy
targets.first_falsification: Obtain licensed verified throughput, gate fees, yields, disposal liabilities and local regulatory limits; calculate spread in both success and adverse scenarios

targets.strategy: Sensor data quality and flood early-warning implementation gaps
targets.geography: Potential Taiwanese civil/industrial deployments only with local permission and demand
targets.capture_method: Integrate and validate resilient alert algorithms for an owner-operated non-critical testbed before investigating procurement or service capture
targets.owner_thesis: A bounded NaN bug and testable patch offer technical knowledge asymmetry, not proof of public-safety effectiveness or a funded buyer
targets.first_falsification: Test real sensor latency and missing-data behavior with qualified operators; confirm alert delivery and false-alarm outcomes before proposing procurement

targets.strategy: Low-cost sensor deployment and practical classroom ventilation measurement
targets.geography: Taiwan campus and schools, subject to device ownership and institutional approval
targets.capture_method: Validate measurement, calibration and low-cost integration alternatives rather than sell unlicensed configuration examples
targets.owner_thesis: The existing sensor component has a static configuration problem and unresolved code rights; educational relevance alone does not prove a deployable service
targets.first_falsification: Establish component license and device availability, calibrate with a reference sensor, and collect permitted observational data before estimating any benefit

targets.strategy: Energy-management tender requirements versus reusable telemetry components
targets.geography: Public international procurement evidence, with Taiwan adaptation requiring separate market checks
targets.capture_method: Look for legally usable interface components satisfying narrow telemetry subrequirements; capture avoided build cost in our own systems before bidding
targets.owner_thesis: A public requirement and DLMS/COSEM parsing repository appear adjacent in the atlas, but tenders may be closed and the component may not address operations or qualification
targets.first_falsification: Check notice lifecycle and eligibility, then validate the exact data protocol and physical meter compatibility; do not assume a funded award is accessible

targets.strategy: Food redistribution and cooperative software reliability improvements
targets.geography: Open-source international deployments; self-use only with authorized rights and operational users
targets.capture_method: Reuse validated source-level failure knowledge to improve a permitted local implementation or avoid wasted integration effort
targets.owner_thesis: Map-centering and order-rounding bugs are reproducible bounded repairs but are not automatically solutions to food redistribution outcomes or commercial demand
targets.first_falsification: Verify separate concrete user problems, full Rails or Angular integration and maintainer rights before linking any operational impact to technical fixes
